purpose: Dependency-complete input set for the Cloudflare Portal Preview pull_request paths filter. A Pull Request whose changed files match none of these patterns cannot change the output of `npm --prefix apps/docs-site run check`, so its Preview build is skipped at zero hosted cost. Derived 2026-10-09 by tracing every read that escapes apps/docs-site (repo-facts.mjs, host/release changelog projection, test-tier content asserts, executed shell entry points). A new external read requires editing code under apps/docs-site/, which is itself covered; tests/build/ci_cloudflare_preview_paths_test.py proves set equality with the workflow, coverage of every traced input, and pattern liveness.
